scope: Read-only suitability audit for the registered GDT872 directional whole-pair profile; no manuscript payload was opened and no data run was performed.

target_contract.pairs: cheor/sheor and cheo/sheo anchors plus the nine other disjoint GDT762 pair strata; exact whole surfaces only.
target_contract.observations: within/across strict source paragraphs, directed lags 3–8 and near lags 1–2.
target_contract.claim_ceiling: descriptive raw-group/paragraph position profile; no lexeme, translation, semantic direction, or authorial meaning.

findings.finding: load_corpus orders normalized ZL3b cleaned tokens by token_index, checks line/token/cross-reader parity, and exposes strict paragraph membership. Its indices are cleaned reader token ordinals; they are not raw authorial-group positions or raw whole boundaries.
GDT807 cross-reader fields all_three_present/all_present_exact are line-level presence fields. They do not establish position parity, ordered raw groups, or exact whole identity.

GDT868 supplies the correct source-group contract and full-line parity gates: source_group_index/count, separators, fragments, legacy positions, and complete clean-line equality. Its published scope is only the fixed 1,777 CORE13 events/1,403 focal loci, so its result cannot be generalized to GDT872 pairs.

GDT762 explicitly calls DRY_SIDE/MOIST_SIDE analyst labels rather than decoded EVA meanings; the eleven pair strata are a bounded whole-form comparison universe, suitable as navigation and pair labels only.

smallest_reuse.reuse: Reuse GDT807 strict paragraph construction and fold/paragraph identifiers for paragraph scope; add a guarded selector-first source-group projection modeled on GDT868 for every GDT872 candidate locus.
smallest_reuse.preclassification_gate: For each candidate line and all three readings, reconstruct the complete ordered raw-group row and require exact full-line fragment/clean-vector parity before assigning candidate position or lag. Exclude or separately flag NORMALIZED_WHOLE and CLEANER_FRAGMENT; never call cleaned token lag raw-manuscript lag.
smallest_reuse.position_definition: Use source_group_index within a parity-passing line for raw-group order; use strict paragraph IDs from GDT807 for paragraph scope. Keep cross-reader all_present_exact as a separate availability flag.

decision: Do not run the scaffold as currently written. It becomes source-suitable after the guarded raw-group projection and GDT868-style full-line parity gate are added. No new image, transcription admission, or meaning evidence is needed for this source-contract repair.

This is a retrospective deterministic audit of the unchanged1777GDT808 events
used by GDT865, not a new significance test, learned decoder or model refit.
GDT808's unique-forced LCS and rank stability operate on clean token vectors.
The atlas maps raw groups to an older interlinear vector, so its positions
cannot be assumed identical to the current clean vectors without full-line
parity. GDT819 performed that comparison for a different small local panel;
no checked primary report has performed it for this entire fixed event set.

## Gates before classification

1. Require exactly1777unique event IDs and unchanged carrier/axis/surface/page/
   locus/token_index against865. Read the three position fields from808,
   preserving the recorded IT/RF1-based unique-LCS ordinals.
2. For every focal(page,locus) and all three readings, reconstruct the complete
   ordered source-group row. Require indices1..n, consistent declared group
   counts, fragment counts and ZERO/ONE/MULTI_ASCII_FRAGMENT statuses,
   consecutive comma-separated legacy token positions, and adjacent separator
   agreement. Do not confuse group indices with legacy token positions.
3. Require the concatenated whitespace-split fragments to equal the full
   corresponding current cross-reader clean vector, not just the target word.
   Any mismatch stops the entire mapping audit; no manual offset repair,
   salvage subset, alignment relaxation or replacement event.
4. Only after all full lines pass, each stored event position must resolve
   uniquely and its fragment must exactly equal the fixed event surface.
   Missing, ambiguous or mismatching source contracts stop without classification.

Of the unchanged1,777CORE13events, **1,767 are exact literal whole raw groups
in all three readings** (99.44%).1,776 are single source groups in allthree
readings, allowing normalization. Exactlyone event is a cleaner fragment in
one reading. This supports the source-group basis of the fixed formal targets;
it does not validate model features, native wordhood or any meaning.

All4,209full reader-lines (1,403focal loci×three alternate readings) pass

Group indices, counts, legacy positions and adjacent separators also agree.
All5,331fixed target positions map uniquely to the expected clean surface.
These are three readings of one manuscript, not independent witnesses.

limitations: GDT868 exact counts concern its fixed CORE13 event set and cannot be used as GDT872 pair coverage.
A cleaned token sequence can support a descriptive normalized profile, but it cannot be relabeled as raw authorial group order without the added projection and parity gate.
The directional profile remains descriptive and does not establish that pair sides encode dry/moist meanings.
